LIT-001.title: Late evening apartment ambient
LIT-001.description: Warm tungsten apartment lighting, late evening natural window light fading to dusk. Intimate, warm-toned practical lamps. Natural evening light from apartment windows.

LIT-002.title: Festival projection screening light
LIT-002.description: Dark theater lighting during film projection. Soft key from the projected image on Maya's face. Intimate single-source lighting from the screen.

LIT-003.title: Film set production lighting
LIT-003.description: Professional film production lighting setup. Key, fill, and practical lighting on set. Bright, controlled, cinematic day-for-night lighting scheme.

CH-001.name: MAYA
CH-001.description: 28-year-old cinematographer with worn film school loans and dreams bigger than her day job. Driven, ambitious, anxious but hopeful.

wardrobe.head: Dark wavy hair, shoulder-length, naturally textured
wardrobe.torso: Casual home wear - soft sweater or t-shirt, well-worn but clean

CH-002.name: JAMES
CH-002.description: 32-year-old partner, supportive but pragmatic. Grounded, steady presence. Brings coffee and emotional support.

CH-003.name: CAROL
CH-003.description: Maya's mother, proud and emotional. Tears streaming as she hears the news of the win.

CH-004.name: DAVID
CH-004.description: 55-year-old veteran cinematographer and mentor who believed in Maya when she was shooting wedding videos. Experienced, wise, supportive.

PRP-001.title: Laptop
PRP-001.description: Maya's laptop for checking festival results. Modern professional equipment, worn from use.

PRP-002.title: Email notification
PRP-002.description: The email announcement of the festival win. Catalyst moment for the entire story.

PRP-003.title: Coffee
PRP-003.description: Coffee brought by James. Warm beverage in ceramic mug.

PRP-004.title: Camera equipment
PRP-004.description: Professional camera gear used to shoot the award-winning film. 16mm camera and accessories.

PRP-005.title: Director's chair
PRP-005.description: The director's chair on a professional film set. Canvas and wood, bearing Maya's name.

LOC-001.title: Small apartment
LOC-001.description: Late evening in a small apartment. Intimate living space where the story opens and climactic moment occurs. Worn, lived-in, with practical furnishings, desk, laptop area.

LOC-002.title: Film festival venue
LOC-002.description: International film festival screening venue. Professional projection space where the film is shown to an audience of filmmakers.

LOC-003.title: Film production set
LOC-003.description: A real film production set with crew, cameras, monitors, and full production infrastructure. Professional, busy, controlled environment with director's chair.
